inspected: actual b176 source collection via background Blender audit

targetObservations.shapeVolume: Stack of varied cobalt stone blocks with softened chamfers, an intentionally broad top cap and a coherent wall-corner depth return. Large upper and lower stones carry the mass; small packed stones provide rhythm. Preserve this useful native modeling opportunity rather than old topology.
targetObservations.color: Cyan upper planes, saturated cobalt middle and deep navy recess/base, all within the original blue family. Target has strong directional edge accents that must become symmetric world lighting, not fixed screen paint.
targetObservations.light: Warm-soft style means generous smooth light transitions and broad highlights on softened edges; keep faceted rock planes legible. Do not copy cyan outline halos.
targetObservations.craftedDetail: Readable recessed stone courses and varied stone widths with several small packing stones; no requirement to copy exact stones or target pixel placement.
targetObservations.readability: Major block boundaries should survive 192x352 logical and phone-scale consumption; close dark seams must not collapse into a bottom black slab. Target itself cannot certify camera or unseen faces.

sourceObservations.original: Original S snapshot is a mostly uninterrupted cyan/cobalt block, dark lower third, slight beveled top and side; it lacks intentional stone construction and crafted surface rhythm.
sourceObservations.nonfunctionalFreedom: Original part counts, flat facets and blank expanse are descriptive source facts, not locks. Stone segmentation, chamfer topology and purposeful detail may improve.
sourceObservations.functionalPending: Measure native join planes/profiles and canonical middle context next; no AABB face automatically declared a port.
